purpose: Archive an unpatched W1L1 ascent whose runtime state matches the statically recovered blocked-ascent response, while preserving the exact helper-attribution limitation.

method.approach: 20 samples of KBD_right held for 30 guest frames each
method.sampling: 30 guest frames between samples, then 1 frame after sample 21
method.callback_capture: focused 01F7:3FF8, complete 0x78-byte record, minimal global/pool snapshots
method.command: args=(); for _ in $(seq 1 20); do args+=(--player-input-phase KBD_right:30); done; python3 research/tools/quikytrace.py --launch --headless --select-level W1L1 --timeout 120 --player-trace --player-focus-callback --player-minimal-callback-capture --player-capture-record --player-samples 40 --player-frames-between 30 --player-frames-between-after-sample 21 --player-frames-between-after 1 --player-collision-event-limit 1 --player-collision-repeat-limit 1 --player-watch-execute 0x1f7:0x41c1 --player-watch-execute 0x1f7:0x41cf --player-watch-execute 0x1f7:0x3d02 --player-watch-execute 0x1f7:0x3df2 ${args[@]} --player-input-phase KBD_right+KBD_space+KBD_up:5 --output /tmp/player-w1l1-natural-ceiling-watched-v3.json

execute_watch_window.caveat: The 3D02 watch is recorded in the post-boundary callback window; the exact mode write occurs between callback barriers, so this does not by itself attribute the write to 3D02.

proves: The route reaches the same observable mode and velocity reversal as the static blocked-ascent response without a coordinate patch.
The transition is followed by positive vertical velocity and descent.
does_not_prove: that the event is a ceiling rather than another natural vertical descriptor boundary
that 41C1 or 41CF performed the mode write
the descriptor word or exact probe order at the write boundary
next: Treat this route as an ordinary-apex control. Use a separate route through a flagged descriptor tile for ceiling/one-way classification.
